title: ‘Maricarmen,’ Whose Eviction Enraged Spaniards, Dies at 87
summary_full: María del Carmen Abascal, aged and ailing, became a symbol of the country’s housing crisis when she was evicted two weeks ago, prompting mass protests and triggering national elections.
